en.name: Mozzarella, drained or block
en.summary: This covers the dry block sold for cooking and any fresh ball you have poured the brine off. Unopened vacuum-packed block keeps 3–4 weeks in the fridge. A drained fresh ball is a different animal: eat it within 1–2 days. Frozen, 1–2 months, grated.
en.pantry: Neither kind belongs at room temperature. Low-moisture block is drier and saltier than a fresh ball, but it is still a chilled cheese; a fresh ball out of its brine is a wet, low-acid cheese and spoils quickly in a warm kitchen. Follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F). Grate the block cold — it grates far better straight from the fridge than at room temperature.
en.fridge: Unopened vacuum-packed low-moisture mozzarella keeps 3–4 weeks at 0–5 °C, or to its printed date. That is the number borrowed from firm, salted, vacuum-packed cheese; it is not a figure for a ball in brine. Here is the thing most shoppers are never told: brine is not packing liquid, it is preservation. A fresh ball you have drained has lost its protection — the salted liquid was keeping the surface hostile and stopping the curd drying — so it is now an exposed, wet, low-acid cheese and should be eaten within 1–2 days. That figure is our own, reasoned from the loss of the brine, and is not published anywhere, so err short. An opened block is more forgiving: wrap it airtight and treat it as a week's cheese, watching for mould. Mozzarella is a fresh cheese and Listeria monocytogenes grows at fridge temperature, so buy it pasteurised.
en.freezer: The block freezes for 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F) and does it well if you grate it first: bag the gratings flat with the air pressed out, and scatter them straight from frozen onto a pizza. A drained fresh ball freezes badly — it thaws watery and rubbery — and is only worth doing for cooking. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the timeline is about quality.
en.thawing: Use grated frozen mozzarella straight from the freezer. If you must thaw a piece, do it wrapped in the fridge and use it cooked; do not refreeze it.
spoilage: Mould, often blue-green or grey, on the cut face or in the folds of the wrapper.
A slimy or sticky surface on the block.
A sour, yeasty or fermented smell instead of a mild milky one.
A fresh ball gone yellow at the surface, or sitting in cloudy, ropy liquid.
tips: Keep a fresh ball in its brine until the moment you use it.
If you have drained a ball, plan to eat it that day or the next.
Grate a block before freezing; it is far more useful that way.
Wrap an opened block airtight — it dries and hardens quickly.

faq.q: How long does drained mozzarella last?
faq.a: A fresh ball you have poured the brine off should be eaten within 1–2 days. That figure is our own conservative reading, not a published one.

faq.q: How long does block mozzarella keep?
faq.a: About 3–4 weeks unopened at 0–5 °C, or to its printed date. An opened block is roughly a week's cheese, wrapped airtight.

faq.q: Should you keep mozzarella in its liquid?
faq.a: Yes, for a fresh ball. The brine is preservation, not packing liquid, and draining it shortens the cheese's life dramatically.
The block freezes well for 1–2 months at −18 °C, ideally grated. A drained fresh ball freezes poorly and is only good for cooking afterwards.

zh.name: 瀝乾／磚型莫札瑞拉
zh.summary: 這一篇談的是料理用的乾式磚型莫札瑞拉，以及任何被你把鹽水倒掉的新鮮起司球。未開封的真空磚冷藏可放 3～4 週。瀝乾的新鮮球完全是另一回事：請在 1～2 天內吃完。冷凍（刨絲）可放 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 兩種都不能放室溫。低水分磚型比新鮮球更乾更鹹，但仍然是冷藏乳酪；離開鹽水的新鮮球則是含水量高、酸度低的乳酪，在溫暖的廚房裡壞得很快。請守 2 小時原則，超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。磚型要刨絲請趁冰的時候刨，比回溫後好刨得多。
zh.fridge: 未開封的真空低水分莫札瑞拉在 0～5 °C 下可放 3～4 週，或以標示日期為準。這個數字借自「結實、含鹽、真空包裝乳酪」，並不是泡在鹽水裡那種球的數字。而下面這件事，幾乎沒有人告訴消費者：鹽水不是填充液，它就是保存手段。把鹽水倒掉的新鮮球等於失去了保護——那些鹽水原本讓表面維持不利微生物的狀態，也防止凝乳乾裂——現在它就是一塊暴露、潮濕、低酸的乳酪，請在 1～2 天內吃完。這個數字是我們從「失去鹽水」推導出來的判斷，沒有任何機構公告過，所以寧可抓短。開封後的磚型比較寬容：密封包好，當成一週左右的乳酪，並注意有沒有長霉。莫札瑞拉屬於新鮮乳酪，而李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍會生長，請選巴氏殺菌品。
zh.freezer: 磚型在 −18 °C 下可放 1～2 個月，先刨絲效果最好：壓平裝袋、擠出空氣，之後直接從冷凍撒到披薩上。瀝乾的新鮮球冷凍表現很差——解凍後又水又橡皮——只值得拿來入菜。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，期限講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 刨絲冷凍的莫札瑞拉直接從冷凍庫拿出來用。真要解凍整塊，請連包裝放冷藏，解凍後加熱使用，不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 切面或包裝摺縫處長霉，常是藍綠色或灰色。
聞起來發酸、有酵母味或發酵味，而不是淡淡奶香。
新鮮球表面泛黃，或泡在混濁牽絲的液體裡。
tips: 新鮮球要用的那一刻之前，都讓它泡在鹽水裡。
已經把鹽水倒掉的話，請當天或隔天就吃完。
磚型冷凍前先刨絲，實用性差很多。
開封的磚型要密封包好——它乾得快、也硬得快。

faq.q: 瀝乾的莫札瑞拉可以放多久？
faq.a: 把鹽水倒掉的新鮮球請在 1～2 天內吃完。這個數字是我們保守的判讀，不是公告值。

faq.q: 磚型莫札瑞拉可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封在 0～5 °C 下約 3～4 週，或以標示日期為準。開封後大約是一週左右的乳酪，要密封包好。

faq.q: 莫札瑞拉要泡在原本的水裡嗎？
faq.a: 新鮮球要。那是鹽水，是保存手段而不是填充液，倒掉之後保存期會大幅縮短。
磚型可以，刨絲後在 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。瀝乾的新鮮球冷凍表現差，解凍後只能入菜。
